name: Cluster + factor analysis of high-DSI/high-PD cells (t0102 + t0104, symmetric vs asymmetric)
short_description: Pool all cells from t0102 and t0104 with DSI > 0.2 AND PD > 3 Hz, classify by morphological asymmetry, run PCA cluster analysis on intrinsic params, and factor analysis (incl. morphology) on what explains DSI / PD diversity.
